title: A 30 second ultra realistic handheld POV video set in France at around 3 am…
prompt:
A 30 second ultra realistic handheld POV video set in France at around 3 am, outside a busy bar and nightlife street. The camera is the point of view of a young woman filming one handed on an iPhone. We never see the phone itself at any point. The footage must feel like raw, authentic amateur nightlife footage with natural iPhone aesthetics.

It is very late. People are leaving bars, smoking outside, waiting for Ubers, talking too loudly, eating kebabs, laughing in tired, sloppy groups. The mood in the street is a mix of drunken energy and visible exhaustion. Faces look tired, makeup is slightly worn, outfits are a bit messy after a long night. The pavement is slightly wet and reflects neon signs, headlights, and warm bar lights. The air feels cold and heavy. The whole scene must feel intensely real, socially awkward, and uncomfortable.

The camera operator is a woman, and her friend is another young woman walking a few steps ahead of her, visibly angry. The camera follows her in a shaky, one-handed handheld way. The tension is already there from the first second. The argument is about the friend disappearing with a guy inside the bar and leaving the camera operator alone for nearly an hour, which made her miss the last train and feel abandoned. This is the core of the argument.

The friend suddenly turns around while still walking and says in natural French from France:

“Tu vas me suivre encore longtemps comme ça ?”

The woman behind the camera replies, irritated and hurt:

“Bah ouais, parce que tu m’as laissée toute seule comme une conne pendant une heure.”

The friend rolls her eyes, tired and defensive:

“Oh ça va, j’étais pas ‘avec un mec’, on parlait, c’est bon.”

The camera gets a little closer as the woman filming answers immediately:

“Mais arrête, tu m’as complètement lâchée. J’te cherchais partout.”

The friend stops walking and turns fully toward the camera now, angry but exhausted:

“J’allais pas te tenir la main toute la soirée non plus.”

A few people nearby start glancing at them. Someone exits a bar laughing, a smoker looks over, a taxi passes in the background. The world keeps moving around them, but the argument becomes the emotional center of the scene.

The woman filming replies, more intense now:

“C’est pas ça le problème, le problème c’est que t’as disparu sans rien dire. J’ai raté le dernier train à cause de toi.”

The friend laughs bitterly in disbelief:

“À cause de moi ? Sérieux ? T’es incapable de te débrouiller toute seule ?”

The camera jolts slightly from the emotional reaction. The breathing of the woman filming becomes more noticeable. Her voice gets sharper:

“Mais t’abuses en fait. Tu fais toujours ça. Tu penses qu’à toi.”

The friend steps closer, now visibly losing patience:

“Et toi tu fais quoi là ? Tu me filmes en pleine rue comme une malade.”

The woman behind the camera replies immediately:

“Parce que tu racontes n’importe quoi !”

The friend reaches toward the camera, not to grab a visible phone, but clearly trying to push it away from her face. The image jerks sideways hard from the contact.

“Enlève ça de ma tête !”

The camera operator snaps back:

“Me touche pas !”

Now the tension breaks completely. The friend, furious and emotionally overwhelmed, shouts:

“Mais ferme-la un peu !”

The woman filming fires back:

“Sinon quoi ?!”

There is a half-second pause. Heavy breathing. Eye contact directly into the lens. Then the friend lunges.

She pushes into the camera operator. The footage becomes chaotic and violent, shaking hard as the woman filming loses balance. She lets out a shocked cry:

“Putain !”

The camera stumbles backward and drops toward the ground. As it falls, we catch blurred fragments: legs, jackets, streetlights, pavement, people turning around, someone shouting:

“Eh oh ! Ça va pas ou quoi ?!”

The friend jumps onto her as both fall out of balance. The camera lands badly on the ground, still recording for a split second, partly blocked by clothing or the ground. We hear struggling, overlapping voices, panic, and nearby people reacting. Then the video abruptly cuts.

The entire performance must feel spontaneous, messy, and completely believable. Natural interruptions, overlapping dialogue, breath, hesitation, frustration, and tiny realistic body movements are essential. The acting must feel like a real late night argument between two exhausted friends, not a scripted drama. No cinematic polish, no stylized fight choreography, no slow motion, no music, no visible phone, no artificial lighting setup, and no glamorous performance. It must feel like a real one handed iPhone recording captured in the heat of the moment.

title: Create a cinematic 11-second 1080p video in 16:9 aspect ratio, photorealistic…
prompt:
Create a cinematic 11-second 1080p video in 16:9 aspect ratio, photorealistic live-action horror-thriller style. Exact emotional performance and intensity of the viral restaurant breakdown scene. Shot on 35mm anamorphic lens with shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, warm restaurant color grade mixed with cold undertones on the face.

The video consists of four seamless connected shots with perfect character consistency, lighting continuity and escalating tension:

Shot 1 (0-2s): Medium close-up of a young woman in her early 20s sitting at a restaurant table at night. Long dark wavy hair, natural soft makeup, delicate features, wearing a simple elegant dark top. Soft warm practical lighting from overhead pendant lamps and candles creates gentle highlights on her skin and soft shadows under her cheekbones. She is looking across the table with a soft, loving, almost dreamy smile, eyes full of affection, slightly leaning forward. Camera holds steady at eye level.

Smooth continuous push-in to Shot 2 (2-4.5s): Extreme close-up on her face. Suddenly her expression freezes completely. The warm smile dies in an instant. Her eyes go vacant for a beat, micro-muscles around her mouth and eyes tighten unnaturally. She begins shaking her head in tiny, sharp side-to-side movements and starts saying in a flat, empty voice: “No… no, no.” Camera continues slowly pushing even closer into her eyes and mouth.

Cut to Shot 3 (4.5-8s): Extreme close-up remains locked as the panic explodes. She rapidly and frantically repeats “No no no no no no no no” with increasing speed, volume and strain. Her eyes widen unnaturally, eyebrows rise high, mouth stretches into a forced unnatural smile mixed with pure dread. Shoulders tense hard. She suddenly stands up from the chair with abrupt, defensive body language, still looking down. She almost yells, voice cracking: “DON’T DO THAT! I THOUGHT WE WERE HAVING A NICE DAY!” Camera pulls back slightly into a tight medium close-up to capture her standing movement while staying focused on her face and upper body.

Final Shot 4 (8-11s): Medium close-up as she forces herself to sit back down quickly. She tries to recover the previous soft expression but fails. A broken, strained smile flickers on and off. She lets out a short, hollow, forced laugh and says in a trembling, overly cheerful tone while her eyes remain dead and panicked: “Why does it matter? I thought we were having a nice day…” Her hands slightly tremble on the table. Camera holds steady on her face as the forced smile cracks one last time.

Native audio with perfect lip-sync: quiet restaurant ambient chatter and soft cutlery sounds that become distant and muffled during the peak panic, then return muted. Exact original delivery rhythm and emotional intensity of the “No no no” escalation and the “Don’t do that” outburst. No music.

Maintain photorealistic skin texture, accurate micro-expressions, realistic hair and fabric movement, coherent physics, and identical facial features, hair, clothing and body proportions of the young woman across every frame and shot. High-fidelity cinematic quality.

title: Use @Image1 as the visual reference for the overall visual language: low-angle…
prompt:
Use @Image1 as the visual reference for the overall visual language: low-angle cinematic composition, two martial artists clashing in mid-air, warm sunlight, blue sky, airborne dust, dramatic fabric movement and realistic live-action kung-fu choreography.

Create a 30-second, 16:9 cinematic kung-fu action sequence in one continuous long take. Exactly two original adult East Asian martial artists wearing loose off-white traditional kung-fu uniforms. The location is an empty old-fashioned Chinese restaurant before opening, with long wooden tables, stools, a narrow counter, bamboo baskets, stacked wooden crates, hanging paper lanterns, fabric curtains and large wooden shutters.

Use the environment naturally during the fight. Tables, stools, counters and screens may be pushed, kicked, vaulted over or used as shields. The objects must feel heavy and physically believable. No tea, no teacups, no food close-ups, no weapons, no dialogue, no music. Use only impact sounds, footsteps, wood breaking, fabric snaps, wind and swirling dust.

0–3 seconds — HOOK:
Start at floor level inside the restaurant. The front wooden door suddenly bursts open. One fighter slides across the floor underneath a long table toward the camera while the other fighter leaps over the counter behind him. A flying foot passes within centimeters of the lens. The opening must be instantly fast, dangerous and cinematic.

3–6 seconds:
The sliding fighter rolls up and grabs the edge of the wooden table, flipping it upright as a shield. The opponent kicks the table aside and uses a stool as a step to launch into a high spinning kick. The camera tracks between the table legs and follows the movement at a low angle.

6–9 seconds:
They exchange rapid close-range punches and elbow blocks beside the counter. One fighter slams the opponent onto the counter, but the opponent rolls across it, kicks a stack of bamboo baskets into the air and escapes through the falling baskets.

9–12 seconds:
The fight moves through a narrow aisle between tables. One fighter jumps from tabletop to tabletop while the other sweeps the tables aside with powerful kicks. Wooden stools spin across the floor, curtains whip in the air and dust rises with every landing.

12–15 seconds:
The opponent grabs a hanging lantern cord and swings around a wooden support beam, using the momentum to deliver a flying side kick. The other fighter blocks with a metal serving tray, creating a sharp metallic impact, then throws the tray aside and counters with a spinning back kick.

15–18 seconds — FALSE VICTORY:
One fighter is driven through a folding paper screen and crashes into stacked crates. The standing fighter pauses in the dust, believing the fight is over. For one quiet second, only the swinging lantern and drifting dust remain.

18–21 seconds:
The fallen fighter suddenly plants one hand on the floor and launches into a low spinning recovery. He sweeps the standing fighter’s legs, jumps over him and kicks him backward into the wooden counter. The counter shakes violently but does not completely break.

21–24 seconds:
Both fighters rush toward each other through the wreckage. One uses the fallen tabletop as a springboard, while the other rebounds off the wall and twists through the air. Their bodies cross in a powerful mid-air collision directly in front of the camera.

24–28 seconds — BIG TECHNIQUE:
The nearer fighter runs across the long wooden table, leaps onto the counter, grabs the hanging lantern cord and swings in a wide circular arc across the entire restaurant. At the highest point, he releases the cord and performs a spectacular 360-degree spinning double kick. The opponent blocks with the tabletop, but the force drives him backward through the front wooden shutters. Wood splinters outward as bright sunlight floods into the dark restaurant.

28–30 seconds — FINAL PAYOFF:
The camera follows through the broken storefront. The defeated fighter rolls across the dusty street and stops. The victorious fighter lands in the ruined doorway. Dust slowly settles, the hanging shop bell swings and rings exactly once, and both fighters remain frozen in a tense final pose. End on the wide view of the destroyed restaurant, drifting dust and warm sunlight.

Maintain consistent faces, bodies and clothing throughout. Exactly two fighters, no extra characters, no duplicated limbs, no distorted anatomy, no magical powers, no blood and no random destruction. The choreography must remain readable, practical and physically grounded, with the final swinging-rope double kick as the visual climax.

title: BMX: Create a 30 second photorealistic cinematic documentary video in 16:9 at 30…
prompt:
Create a 30 second photorealistic cinematic documentary video in 16:9 at 30 frames per second inside a modest chiropractic treatment room. It must feel like genuine unscripted social media footage, with believable anatomy, natural skin texture, subtle breathing, realistic fabric folds, accurate hand contact, consistent proportions, and continuous motion.

A slim athletic woman in her late thirties wears a dark forest green sleeveless workout top and matching leggings, with brown hair in a slightly messy bun. A calm male practitioner in his early thirties wears a faded pale yellow graphic shirt, loose brown trousers, and a gray towel over one shoulder. The room has white walls, a black segmented treatment table, a deep green cushion, an orange cabinet, a warm lamp, framed anatomy charts, and discreet clinical equipment. Bright ceiling panels create neutral soft light.

At 0 to 3 seconds open with a close medium shot of the practitioner carefully supporting the seated woman’s head and shoulder. Use a quick natural handheld push closer, then show one small controlled movement, a restrained release sound, her surprised inhale, and a relieved laugh. No exaggerated twisting.

At 3 to 7 seconds cut to a centered eye level medium shot. She touches the right side of her neck and lower back while describing years of tightness, vulnerable but composed. The practitioner listens behind her. Use subtle camera sway and realistic pauses.

At 7 to 11 seconds show a brief mobility assessment from a wider three quarter angle. He gently guides her head left and right while watching her range. Add one close insert of his hands safely positioned at the jaw and upper neck, then her cautious side glance. Preserve wardrobe, hair, room layout, and hand placement across every cut.

At 11 to 17 seconds show her lying on her side with her head on the green cushion. Frame a medium side view as he positions her bent leg and supports her shoulder and pelvis. She exhales, he applies one controlled adjustment, and the camera gives a tiny involuntary shake at the release. Cut close as she laughs in disbelief and relaxes.

At 17 to 22 seconds return to the seated position. In an intimate front three quarter shot he places the gray towel softly behind her neck, checks her comfort, and performs one gentle controlled cervical adjustment. Her shoulders drop. Capture a quiet breath, moist eyes, and a small smile, never theatrical emotion.

At 22 to 27 seconds hold a close medium shot while she touches her neck, turns her head farther than before, and becomes tearful with relief. The practitioner steps back. Use a slow handheld drift inward, realistic depth of field, and detailed facial micro expressions.

At 27 to 30 seconds use a wider final shot. She stands, bends forward to test her movement, rises smiling, then gives the practitioner a brief grateful hug. End with her touching her neck and laughing softly, with the orange cabinet and anatomy chart visible.

Edit with clean straight cuts and one subtle match cut between the opening and later seated adjustment. Use restrained grading with natural greens, warm yellow, soft orange accents, realistic highlight rolloff, and fine sensor grain. Avoid beauty filters, plastic skin, warped hands, duplicated limbs, unstable backgrounds, impossible neck motion, extreme cracking, medical claims, text, logos, captions, watermarks, or voiceover.

Audio includes room tone, clothing movement, table creaks, soft breathing, dialogue murmurs, one restrained adjustment sound, and her genuine laugh. Add minimal emotional music with low pulsing piano and muted percussion at the start, warm cello and soft ambient pads after the first release, and a gentle hopeful chord during the final hug. Keep music beneath the human reactions.

Genuine smartphone selfie recording aesthetic. Unscripted personal confessional feel. Natural daylight cinematography. Unfiltered raw emotional delivery with no performance polish. Strong environmental realism — the texture of the car interior, the quality of windshield light, the natural acoustics of the cabin. CAMERA STYLE: 9:16 vertical smartphone front-camera selfie composition. The phone is propped against the dashboard or steering column at a slight natural angle — the frame has a barely perceptible tilt left, not perfectly level. Electronic stabilization introduces a subtle jelly-effect wobble on sudden head movements and hand gestures entering frame. Auto-exposure subtly fluctuates as she leans forward or rocks back, brightening and dimming in real time. Front-facing wide-angle lens produces very slight barrel distortion around her head and shoulders at the edges. Visible digital sharpening halo around high-contrast transitions — her hair against the bright windshield. Compression artifacts in darker shadow areas of the cabin. The frame occasionally drifts a millimeter or two as the phone's propped position settles. Brief motion blur when she gestures sharply into frame. No cinematic camera movement. No stabilizer or gimbal. No modern color grading — straight phone-camera color science with its characteristic slightly boosted contrast and cool tint. TIMELINE — Single continuous selfie recording, approximately 30 seconds: 00:00-00:04 — Leans into camera with a serious expression. "I am manifesting. Only a specific amount of people are gonna see this video." [Imperfect event: Camera shake at start] 00:04-00:08 — Tilts head back, eyes darting upward, then returns gaze forward. "What you wanna be, whatever job," [Imperfect event: Voice crack on "whatever"] 00:15-00:19 — Swings hands outward to dismiss other ideas, pointing dynamically. "I don't care. You wanna live in a certain place, blah, blah," [Imperfect event: Sudden camera wobble] AUDIO: On-location audio captured through the smartphone's built-in microphone. Characteristic phone-mic quality — slightly boxy midrange, compressed dynamic range, the subtle proximity effect when she leans toward the device. Her breathing is clearly audible between phrases — quickened, shallow inhalations that match the escalating pace. The car cabin ambience: the low hum of the ventilation fan, the soft creak of cloth upholstery when she shifts, a faint plastic rattle from somewhere in the dashboard. Muffled outdoor sounds through closed windows: a single bird chirp in a gap of silence, a distant car engine passing, the faint thump of bass from another vehicle far away. No background music. No added sound design. No voiceover narration. OBJECTIVE: Capture a raw, uninterrupted phone-selfie confessional from a young woman in her parked car — a segment of a genuine TikTok video where she is convincing herself through the act of speaking. As if a friend sent this to you directly: real, not rehearsed — earnest, urgent, breathless, unpolished, intimate, confrontational.

title: 画面 (VISUALS)：

场景 2 (Scene 2)： 沿着 @image1 平行移动的低角度对角线跟拍，捕捉她以极高速度、惊恐万分地冲向一排金属闸机。她没有盲目地用身体撞击障碍物；相反，完全凭借肾上腺素的爆发，她将脚重重地踩在湿滑的瓷砖上猛力蹬起，完成了一个极其拼命的、全身越过闸机的腾空动作。摄像机在起跳至跳跃最高点的过程中运用了短暂而高度风格化的慢动作效果，在闪烁的红色应急灯背景下清晰地定格了她悬空的姿态。就在她即将落地的前一瞬，画面猛然恢复实时速度，极大地强调了她落地时那沉重、震颤的物理冲击力。就在她双脚触地的瞬间，身后汹涌的浑浊洪水彻底吞噬了闸机，狂暴地扭曲并折断了沉重的金属。
场景 3 (Scene 3)： 极具威胁感地贴近地面的低角度固定镜头，直指一扇沉重、正在快速下降的钢制防水卷帘门。@image1 从惊慌失措的狂奔完美过渡为在被水淹没的地板上进行低姿态、摩擦式的滑铲，拼命将自己推过迅速缩小的缝隙。就在她的脚尖掠过门槛的绝对瞬间，巨大的钢制卷帘门带着毁灭性的最终冲击力猛砸在混凝土地面上，暂时将恐怖封锁在了门后。

prompt:
16:9, 30 seconds, an epic photorealistic fantasy cinematic long take, original worldbuilding, one continuous shot, continuous camera movement, no hard cuts, and no references to any existing film, character, actor, or recognizable cinematic scene.

OVERALL STYLE:
A high-budget fantasy film aesthetic with realistic cinematography, monumental world scale, and a beautiful protagonist with natural skin, realistic expressions, and believable body proportions. The overall tone is intelligent, elegant, mysterious, and courageous, never childish, cartoonish, or exaggerated cosplay. Four locations are connected through one continuous flight path: Iceland’s black coastline, an alternate Victorian London, a Paris-inspired city at night in the rain, and a futuristic New York-inspired aerial metropolis.

UNIFIED COLOR PALETTE:
Deep black, silver-gray, and warm gold remain the dominant colors throughout the film. Iceland adds cold blue; London adds gray-green and amber; Paris adds deep blue and wet gold; New York adds deep teal, silver-white, and gold. Maintain realistic atmospheric perspective, thin mist, rainfall, wet surfaces, glass reflections, and volumetric light throughout. Avoid a video-game look, concept-art appearance, and plastic materials.

MAIN CHARACTER:
There is only one female protagonist throughout the entire video. She is approximately 28 years old, slender, exceptionally beautiful, intelligent, elegant, and quietly determined. Her refined facial features are completely original and must not copy any real actor or movie character. She has naturally bright eyes, clearly defined eyebrows, a soft but strong facial structure, natural skin tone, realistic skin texture, and a restrained, focused expression.

She has warm chestnut-brown hair reaching her waist, naturally wavy at the ends. Part of her hair is blown behind her shoulders by the wind. Her hairstyle must remain identical throughout the entire film.

She wears a deep forest-green long coat, an ivory high-neck blouse, a dark-red knitted scarf, brown leather wrist guards, dark-gray trousers, and worn leather boots. Her costume has an elevated British fantasy aesthetic, but she does not wear a school uniform or pointed hat. Do not include badges, school emblems, magical-school symbols, recognizable character costumes, or elements from any existing film.

She rides the same original flying broom throughout the sequence: a dark, aged wooden handle with silver-gray metallic fibers at the rear and a small warm-gold light at the front. The broom’s shape, size, color, and materials must never change.

HER OBJECTIVE:
She is flying through different cities to carry the small warm-gold light toward the far edge of the clouds. She is not a combat character. She does not attack anyone or cast explosive magic. She simply continues forward through cities, coastlines, fog, rain, and high-altitude air. Her emotional progression moves from concentration to wonder, then finally to freedom and determination.

0-5 SECONDS: TAKEOFF FROM ICELAND’S BLACK-SAND BEACH
The shot begins extremely low above a black volcanic beach using a 24mm wide-angle lens. Black ocean waves are on the left, towering basalt columns on the right, and blue-white glacial mountains in the distance. Cold blue clouds press down across the sky, while a narrow line of warm golden sunset remains near the horizon.

The beautiful female traveler rapidly enters from the rear right of the frame, riding her broom just above the ocean surface. Her chestnut-brown hair streams backward in the sea wind. Her dark-red scarf creates a clean motion line behind her, while her deep forest-green coat moves naturally in the airflow. The warm-gold light at the front of the broom illuminates the sea mist and droplets of water.

The camera follows her from behind with a stable FPV movement, keeping her slightly right of center. It must not circle around to the front or allow her to leave the frame. Her body leans slightly forward; one hand holds the broom handle while the other maintains balance. She flies toward a massive wall of blue ice.

At the fourth second, she enters a natural裂缝 beneath the ice wall. The ice passes rapidly along both sides of the camera. Cold blue crystals briefly intersect with the warm-gold light, creating the first natural transition. No explosion, magical smoke, or sudden transformation.

5-12 SECONDS: VICTORIAN LONDON IN THE FOG
As the ice clears the lens, the environment naturally becomes an alternate Victorian city at night. The protagonist and broom retain exactly the same direction, speed, clothing, appearance, and flying posture. The camera continues following from behind.

Below are wet dark-gray stone streets. Red-brick buildings, black iron bridges, narrow windows, and old amber streetlamps line both sides. Several dark-red double-decker public vehicles without text or branding move slowly through the fog. The city should evoke Victorian London without reproducing real landmarks.

The camera gradually transitions from fast FPV pursuit into a smooth three-quarter rear tracking shot, moving approximately 45 degrees to her left side. Her beautiful profile appears briefly. Her eyes remain focused, and her hair and scarf maintain stable continuity. The warm-gold light leaves only a short trail through the rain and fog.

She passes beneath a black elevated iron bridge. Its steel structure moves across the top of the frame as a brief physical occlusion. The camera does not cut, and when the obstruction clears, she remains on the same movement axis.

At the tenth second, she flies into a massive arched railway station. Its roof is made from black steel beams and wet glass, with rainwater flowing across the surface. The roof completely covers the frame, creating the second natural transition.

12-19 SECONDS: PARIS-INSPIRED CITY IN THE RAIN
When the glass roof clears the camera, the environment becomes a romantic, original Paris-inspired city at night in the rain. Do not reproduce real landmarks. Preserve only the atmosphere of stone bridges, a river, narrow streets, classical stone buildings, wrought-iron balconies, and warm window light.

The protagonist flies low above a broad river. The water reflects golden windows and the deep-blue night sky. Pale-gray stone buildings, tall narrow windows, wet rooftops, and fine rain lines extend along both sides. Her deep-green coat and dark-red scarf form a clear silhouette against the blue city, while her chestnut hair streams backward.

The camera moves into a parallel tracking position on her right side. The broom stays approximately three meters above the river. The camera remains slightly below shoulder level, preserving the spatial relationship between the woman, broom, river, and architecture. She passes beneath a sequence of classical stone bridges whose arches form continuous reflections in the water.

At the seventeenth second, she enters a long mirror corridor made from wet glass walls. The reflections may show only the same woman, the same broom, and the same warm-gold light. Do not create duplicate people. Rainwater, city lights, and reflections slide along the glass surfaces.

A powerful warm-gold light appears at the end of the corridor. She flies toward it, creating the third natural transition.

19-24 SECONDS: FUTURISTIC NEW YORK-INSPIRED CITY
The mirror corridor opens into an original futuristic New York-inspired metropolis. The camera rapidly but smoothly shifts from the three-quarter rear position into a controlled forward-facing FPV shot moving backward in front of her. Her beautiful, focused face, chestnut hair, dark-red scarf, and the golden broom light are briefly visible.

Below are wet streets, glass skyscrapers, metallic elevated bridges, and enormous urban canyons. The buildings reflect golden light, a deep-teal night sky, and silver-white mist. All screens and glass surfaces must remain abstract and free of text, advertisements, logos, or branding.

She flies between two skyscrapers. The glass wall on the left passes close to the camera, while a vast urban canyon opens on the right. The camera briefly maintains its backward-facing position before completing one stable 90-degree upward movement, transitioning from her face to a position above her.

Do not spin rapidly, make her tumble, or transform the broom into an aircraft. She remains graceful, skilled, and stable.

At the twenty-third second, she bursts out from between the skyscrapers. The city lights rapidly become smaller below her, while the warm-gold light at the front of the broom becomes the only stable light source near the center of the image.

24-30 SECONDS: THE FINAL WORLD ABOVE THE CLOUDS
The camera continues rising at high speed and passes through a dense layer of cloud. When the clouds clear, the protagonist appears high above a vast cloud sea, hovering on her broom.

She gradually slows down and changes from a forward-leaning posture to a more upright position. Her chestnut hair and dark-red scarf move backward in the high-altitude wind. The camera moves from the front to her right rear side, then rises into a high-angle 24mm wide shot.

Distant traces of the four worlds appear below without forming a chaotic collage: Iceland’s black coastline and blue glacier on the far left; London-inspired red-brick structures and gray-green fog in the middle distance; Paris-inspired golden waterways and stone bridges on the right; and silver-white lights from the New York-inspired glass city at the lowest level.

These locations must exist only as distant spatial layers. Do not suddenly reproduce four complete cities or make buildings float and reorganize. A warm golden horizon appears at the edge of the clouds, suggesting that another world is waiting beyond it.

At the twenty-eighth second, the protagonist raises her right hand. The warm-gold light at the front of the broom emits one thin beam toward the horizon. The beam only illuminates a new path through the clouds. It does not explode, create a giant energy sphere, or alter her appearance.

Use crisp realistic detail, true skin texture, fine hair strands, believable fabric folds, accurate hands, subtle breathing, and tiny posture adjustments. She pulls her hand away and reveals the first outfit, a sleeveless pale blue floral office dress with a light scarf over one shoulder. She looks calmly into the camera, lowers her arm, places one hand on her hip, glances upward with a mildly unimpressed expression, then folds her arms. title: Format: cinematic 16:9 animated comedy, 30 seconds, high-quality stylized 2D…

A greenhouse stands on the far left, the entrance gate is centered in the background, and yellow flower beds fill the right side.

Fixed spatial positions
Shy Japanese girl: far left, beside the end of the table.
Duras Dacicus: left background, behind the table.
Officer Lin: center-left, behind a bamboo dumpling steamer.
Grumpy Cat: sitting directly in the center of the table.

Shot 1 — 0:00–0:03

Camera: wide establishing shot from slightly above the garden gate, slowly craning downward toward the long table.

All ten characters are visible in their established positions. The gardener stands proudly beside his flowers with his hands in his orange jacket pockets. Everyone else looks uncertain about why they have been invited.

The gardener announces in English, with forced respectability:

Grumpy Cat slowly turns its head toward him with a deeply suspicious expression.

Sound effects: soft birds, distant bees, leaves rustling, one garden sprinkler clicking rhythmically, leather jacket creaking as the gardener straightens his shoulders.

Shot 2 — 0:03–0:06

Camera: medium frontal push-in on Officer Lin at center-left.

Officer Lin smiles warmly and lifts the lid from a bamboo steamer filled with fresh dumplings. A large cloud of fragrant steam rises around his glasses.

He says cheerfully in Mandarin Chinese:

OFFICER LIN: “请大家先吃饺子，别打架。”

He gestures toward the dumplings, then raises one warning finger on “别打架.”

Sound effects: soft wooden lid knock, strong puff of steam, gentle ceramic plate clink, Officer Lin’s leather satchel buckle jingling.

Shot 3 — 0:06–0:09

Camera: medium two-shot from the opposite side of the table, with Nae in the foreground right and Duras Dacicus in the background left.

Nae immediately leans toward the dumplings, points proudly at them and declares in Romanian:

NAE: “Eu le-am făcut! Se vede după măiestrie.”

Duras slowly turns his head toward Nae, lowers his wooden sword slightly and replies in a deep Romanian voice:

Nae’s proud smile freezes. His moustache twitches indignantly.

Shot 4 — 0:09–0:12

Camera: elegant low-angle close two-shot of Lady Florentine and Madame Gogo Chanel on the right side of the table, with the steamer blurred in the foreground.

Lady Florentine delicately lifts one dumpling with the tip of her ornate cane, inspects it as though evaluating court cuisine and says in French:

LADY FLORENTINE: “C’est rustique… mais acceptable.”

Madame Gogo Chanel leans closer, narrows her eyes at the dumpling’s folds and replies sharply in French:

MADAME GOGO CHANEL: “Non. Le pli est catastrophique.”

She makes a tiny disapproving gesture with one gloved hand.

Sound effects: pearl necklaces softly clicking, cane tip tapping the plate, fabric rustling, Madame Gogo Chanel’s heel tapping once against the ground.

Shot 5 — 0:12–0:15

Camera: over-the-table medium shot toward the Big Good Wolf, with Grumpy Cat large in the foreground.

The Big Good Wolf raises both hands in exasperation and asks in English:

BIG GOOD WOLF: “Are we eating them or reviewing them?”

Grumpy Cat looks directly into the camera and releases one long, irritated:

GRUMPY CAT: “Mrrrraow.”

The wolf slowly lowers his hands, apparently accepting the cat’s authority.

Sound effects: wolf claws lightly tapping the tabletop, suit fabric stretching, cat tail thumping twice against the wood, distant crow calling once.

Shot 6 — 0:15–0:18

Camera: narrow telephoto shot aimed toward the background gate, followed by a slow lateral track.

Zaches creeps out from behind the gate, hunched forward with an enormous mischievous grin. Everyone in the foreground is distracted.

He reaches one long hand toward the bamboo steamer and whispers in German:

ZACHES: “Nur eine ganz kleine Kostprobe…”

He begins sliding the entire steamer toward himself instead of taking one dumpling.

Sound effects: exaggerated quiet tiptoes, coat tails brushing the ground, faint sinister chuckle, bamboo steamer scraping slowly across the table.

Shot 7 — 0:18–0:21

Grumpy Cat’s pupils narrow. Its paw shoots forward and smacks Zaches across the knuckles.

ZACHES: “Aua!”

Everyone looks upward simultaneously.

Sound effects: sharp cat-paw slap, Zaches’s high-pitched yelp, bamboo lid clattering, fast airborne whooshes, several collective gasps.

Shot 8 — 0:21–0:24.5

Camera: fast left-to-right tracking shot following the falling objects, while preserving everyone’s established positions.

Three rapid visual beats occur during the same continuous shot:

Duras catches the empty bamboo steamer flat on the broad side of his wooden sword.
The Big Good Wolf catches the spinning lid on the end of his nose and goes cross-eyed trying to see it.
The shy Japanese girl calmly reaches forward with a pair of chopsticks from the table and catches the final falling dumpling without moving her feet.

She looks at the stunned group and says softly in Japanese:

Officer Lin beams proudly at her.

Sound effects: wooden sword swish, hollow bamboo “tok,” lid landing with a soft “bonk,” chopsticks snapping together, tiny dumpling squish, the girl’s handbag buckle gently jingling.

Shot 9 — 0:24.5–0:27.5

The Big Good Wolf remains frozen with the bamboo lid balanced like an absurd round hat on his nose.

Madame Gogo Chanel studies him seriously and says in French:

Lady Florentine nods with unexpected approval:

LADY FLORENTINE: “Enfin, quelqu’un d’élégant.”

The wolf stares miserably at the camera and mutters in English:

BIG GOOD WOLF: “I hate fashion.”

Sound effects: pearls clicking as both women nod, hat lid wobbling, wolf’s exhausted sigh, one quiet snicker from Nae off-screen.

Everyone turns back toward the dumplings—but the food has vanished.

Grumpy Cat now sits inside the bamboo steamer, cheeks completely full, with one final dumpling held beneath its paw.

The gardener lunges protectively in front of his flower bed and yells in English:

Grumpy Cat swallows, gives a tiny unapologetic meow and places its paw firmly over the last dumpling.

End on the cat’s defiant face as everyone erupts behind it.

0-3秒：开场铃声落下。ATLAS像公牛一样低吼着轰然冲锋，整个擂台木板随他的脚步震颤。他的右拳带着全身重量砸向HARIN面部——HARIN侧头闪过，拳头轰入她身后的角柱，木板炸裂，碎木屑飞溅，绳索剧烈震颤。围观士兵集体后仰。
3-6秒：HARIN趁势以日字冲拳打入ATLAS肋部——但如同击中石墙，ATLAS的肌肉纹丝不动。他反手一记横扫砸在HARIN架起的双臂上，巨力将她整个人击退，布鞋在黄土上犁出两道尘痕，她滑退近两米才稳住。
6-9秒：ATLAS压上，双拳如锤连续砸落。HARIN以膀手和摊手拼命卸力，每次格挡她的全身都被震得晃动。一记落空的重锤砸在擂台木板上，木板凹陷开裂。下一击她以双臂交叉硬接——被巨力压得单膝跪地，牙关紧咬，手腕绑带绷紧。探照灯逆光中ATLAS的剪影笼罩住她。
9-12秒：画面进入慢动作（约25%速度）——ATLAS的巨拳向跪地的HARIN头部轰然砸落。在拳锋距离面部一掌之遥的瞬间，HARIN的眼神骤然锐利，摊手从内侧将巨拳引偏——拳头轰入她脸侧的木板，碎木屑贴着她的脸颊缓缓飞过，发丝被拳风掀起。摄像机环绕两人弧形移动。
12-15秒：慢动作骤然恢复正常速度。HARIN借跪姿弹起钻入ATLAS怀内，转身肘击轰中他的下颌，狗牌项链甩起弧线，紧接连环冲拳两发打入胸口。ATLAS怒吼着一把攥住她的肩头衣襟，像扔沙袋一样将她整个人横抛出去——HARIN在空中扭转身体，重重撞上擂台绳索反弹落地翻滚。
15-18秒：HARIN撑地起身，嘴角渗出一道细血线，几缕黑发散落贴在脸侧，白色武术服沾上黄土。ATLAS咆哮着再度冲锋。她在被撞上的前一瞬以45度侧闪，擸手抓住他冲来的右腕顺势猛拽——ATLAS的巨大惯性收不住，轰然撞进围绳，绳索被撑得深深外凸。
18-21秒：ATLAS转身甩出狂暴的左右摆拳。HARIN以膀手摊手交替卸开，每次架挡她的身体都被震退半步，靴子与布鞋在木板上急促交错。在他一记摆拳打空拉开肋部空档的瞬间，她的连环冲拳连续打入他的肋骨和心口，ATLAS的身体第一次弯折。
21-24秒：ATLAS踉跄但没有倒，咆哮着挥出绝望的下勾拳。HARIN伏手下压截击，借他力量耗尽的瞬间缩入近身，连续五发连环冲拳打入面部和胸口——双拳交替如缝纫机，每一拳在上一拳收回前已击出。ATLAS随每次打击后仰，脚步连续后退，木板连声闷响。围观士兵全部站起。
24-27秒：HARIN沉腰坐马，最后一记掌击以全身结构力推在ATLAS胸口正中。ATLAS向后倒飞三步撞上擂台绳索，双臂搭在绳索上，膝盖半跪，胸膛剧烈起伏，无法起身。
27-30秒：HARIN站在擂台中央，肩膀随粗重的呼吸起伏，散落的发丝贴在汗湿的脸侧，白色武术服上沾着黄土与木屑，嘴角的细血线未擦。她缓缓抬起目光扫过人群，一只手回到咏春中线护手——标指姿势，掌心朝内。灰尘在探照灯光柱中缓缓飘落。四周从死寂变为低沉的骚动。她静立不动。

AUDIO:开场铃声一响即开始。ATLAS的冲锋脚步带沉重低频震动，0-3秒木板炸裂声尖锐爆响。3-9秒：每次重击带下沉的低音冲击声，木板开裂声、绳索绷紧声、HARIN被震退时布鞋摩擦黄土的声音清晰。9-12秒慢动作：所有声音降调拉长——巨拳破空的低频轰鸣、木屑飞过脸颊的细微声、人群呼喊拉长成低吼。12秒恢复正常速度时声音骤然回弹，肘击与抛摔的撞击声、绳索剧烈震颤声爆发。15-24秒：皮肉碰撞声密集，HARIN的短促呼气声与ATLAS的粗重咆哮交错，连环冲拳如鼓点。24秒掌击：一声最深沉的闷响，之后短暂全场死寂。然后人群低沉的骚动涌入，混合ATLAS的喘息与HARIN的粗重呼吸。无背景音乐。只有环境音、打击音、呼吸。

不要随意切换镜头，一镜到底。

title: 基础设定：一段粉发女子在末世荒原一个小镇的教学楼 奔跑 躲避 各种丧尸怪物 的追逐短片。粉发女子：0929dbea-9189-4862-84de-3252215…
prompt: 基础设定：一段粉发女子在末世荒原一个小镇的教学楼 奔跑 躲避 各种丧尸怪物 的追逐短片。粉发女子：0929dbea-9189-4862-84de-325221590cc6Image 53 (1) 视觉基调： 好莱坞经典末世废土重工业电影美学，。画面充斥着强烈的 粗糙胶片颗粒感（Gritty Film Grain）、空气中弥漫的悬浮沙尘微粒（Floating Dust/Sand Particles）以及极高的画面对比度。整体呈现出极具史诗感、荒芜、干涸且硬核的废土生存质感。 光影色调： 采用高反差的 “废墟漫反射与强逆光（Harsh Backlight & Ruin Bounce Light）”，色调方案为极致的 “好莱坞青橙色调（Teal & Orange grading）”。光源设定为透过残破走廊窗户斜射进来的末世黄昏阳光，形成强烈的丁达尔光束。走廊深处及怪物潜伏的暗部呈现深邃且危险的 铁青/褪色蓝灰色（Desaturated Cyan），高光部（飞溅的玻璃渣、扬起的灰尘、破窗外的荒原）则呈现出焦躁的 琥珀色与焦土黄（Amber & Scorched Earth）。整体氛围灼热、绝望、充满生死一线的狂野气息。 摄影手法： 手持沉浸式跟拍（Shaky Handheld POV Tracking）。伴随女主的滑铲、翻滚与狂奔，镜头带有极强烈的生理性剧烈颠簸与重力下坠感。强调 极速焦点转换（Rapid Rack Focus）与 浅景深（Shallow Depth of Field），在女主挂满汗水与污渍的脸部特写、近在咫尺的丧尸利爪，以及破窗跃下瞬间产生的 变形镜头之间凌厉切换，生硬且真实地捕捉高速运动中的物理破坏微小质感。 画面内容： 0-5秒：画面建立在一个废弃教学楼破败不堪的走廊内。墙皮大面积 peeling 脱落，露出内里的钢筋混凝土。地面铺满了腐烂的书籍、发黄的试卷、倾倒的课桌椅和无数玻璃碎片，积满灰尘。废土黄昏的暗金色阳光透过破败的窗户斜射进来，形成高对比度的丁达尔光束（Tyndall effect），空气中飞舞着呛人的灰尘。开场第一帧，伴随着急促而粗重的喘息声，一头凌乱叛逆的粉色短发，身穿黑色紧身背心、超短牛仔裤，脚蹬重型战术军靴，脖子上挂着黑色头戴式耳机）从画面左侧外以极快的冲刺速度奔跑入镜头正前方。镜头距离极近，死死咬住她的背影。女主全速冲向走廊深处。关键时刻：第2秒，就在女主全速跑过一扇破旧教室门（peeling wooden door）的绝对瞬时，一只腐烂干瘪、皮肤呈现灰绿色、指爪尖锐的丧尸怪物（Feral mutant zombie）毫无征兆地从门后的阴影中侧向猛扑而出（Side Lunge），直逼女主的面门，女主展现极致反应，身体在全速奔跑中施展出一个极限侧向倾斜闪避（Hyper-agility evasion, leaning far to the left），怪物那散发着腐烂恶臭的指尖几乎是擦着她的粉色发丝划过。 5-11秒：怪物一击落空，发出一声非人的吼叫，在走廊墙壁上抓出五道深深的火花划痕，稳住身形再次追来。镜头重新稳稳锁定女主狂奔的背影，剧烈晃动手持跟拍（Extreme shaky handheld camera）。每一次沉重的军 boots 砸在布满碎石的瓷砖地面上，镜头都会伴随着脚步产生真实的物理震动，带起大片飞扬的灰尘。前方的走廊被坍塌的天花板和废弃铁皮柜完全堵死。女主根本没有任何减速的迹象，在距离障碍物仅剩一米时，她顺势双膝极速弯曲，整个身体贴着地面向前滑行，紧接着施展出一个流畅的战术前滚翻（Tactical ground roll）。镜头跟随着她的动作进行了一个天旋地转的360度翻滚镜头（360-degree rolling POV follow shot）。她毫发无损地从坍塌障碍物下方的狭窄缝隙中钻过，并在起身的瞬间无缝衔接继续狂奔。 11-17秒：女主头顶上方老旧的通风管道发出一声撕裂般的巨响。一只体型更为庞大、浑身长满坚硬角质层如爬行动物般的巨型变异怪（Reptilian mutant monster）直接撕裂天花板上的铁网，伴随着大量石块、钢筋和粉尘，犹如泰山压顶般砸向女主正前方的必经之路。镜头因怪物的落地而产生剧烈的震荡波（Camera shake from heavy impact）。怪物双臂极其粗壮，发出震耳欲聋的咆哮，挥舞着巨大指爪横扫过来。女主面对这避无可避的必杀一击，瞬间极度下沉身体重心，在布满灰尘的瓷砖地面上施展出一段极度惊险的长距离侧向滑铲（High-speed lateral power slide）。镜头跟随她的身体视角极度贴近地面，完美捕捉到她紧贴着一长排废弃长凳下方高速滑行而过，避开怪物砸碎她经过的墙壁飞溅出的砖块碎屑（Debris explosion）。 17-23秒：第17秒，女主滑铲起身，一个极限急转弯冲入了一间视野开阔的大教室。女主快速跳过倾倒的课桌椅和讲台，向教室一侧一扇巨大但布满裂纹的落地玻璃窗冲去。窗外是废土荒原小镇的黄昏，可以看到远处残破的街道。在距离窗户最后一步时，她腾空而起。 23-30秒：第23秒，飞身破窗动作（Dynamic flying kick breaking glass）。镜头从后方捕捉她凌乱粉发和在飞溅玻璃渣中翻飞的绝美定格。下一刻，她从二楼高楼破窗越层下坠。 沉浸式坠落视角（POV follow high descent）。镜头重新切回越肩视角跟随她下坠，捕捉一楼建筑平台上布满积雪和废旧设备的景物。在即将落地时，她极其专业地利用一个前肩战术翻滚（Shoulder roll landing）卸去巨大的垂直冲击力。怪物紧接着从二楼破窗处砸落在平台边缘，发出震天咆哮。 纵身跃入街道（High Jump Descent into wasteland streets）。女主角落地后根本没有停歇，全速起跑，冲向平台边缘，纵身一跃向下，直接跳入下方布满废弃汽车、倾倒建筑和残破虹灯招牌的废土小镇街道之中。 第30秒，街道隐没定格（Streets maze evasion）。镜头从高处（无人机视角）或怪物视角俯瞰，看着她在废弃汽车迷宫中极敏捷地穿梭并瞬间隐没在一处坍塌建筑物的阴

title: 【风格】游泳姿态美学展示（Swimming Strokes Showcase），电影感写真质感（16:9 Cinematic…
prompt:
【风格】游泳姿态美学展示（Swimming Strokes Showcase），电影感写真质感（16:9 Cinematic, Photorealistic），高速摄影升格（Super Slow-mo），阳光泳池通透水蓝影调，长发水中飘动的唯美运动风
【时长】15秒
【场景】一条极长的泳道，向远处延伸看不到尽头，阳光透过玻璃顶棚斜射入水，在池底投下晃动的光网，水质通透碧蓝，画面里没有出发台、记分屏等比赛元素
【角色】主角@图片1
【结构机制】四种泳姿依次展示，切换全部在水中完成：靠身体滚转（Roll）或下潜滑行（Underwater Glide）自然过渡，不触壁、不转身，一条泳道游到底；每种泳姿约3秒，配一个专属机位和标志性画面

[00:00-00:02.5] 开场：入水滑行（The Glide）
侧面水下机位：她从池边轻盈跃入，身体呈流线型在水下滑行，长发在身后完全舒展开像一片黑色的绸缎，气泡串从指尖向后飞，阳光光柱扫过她的身体。
【音效】入水一声轻"唰"，水下低频的宁静嗡响。

[00:02.5-00:05.5] 第一式：蛙泳（Breaststroke）
正面低水位机位：她浮出水面开始蛙泳，双臂对称外划、双腿蹬夹，身体一收一展从容优雅，每次抬头换气露出全脸，湿发贴在颊边，身前推出一圈圈弧形波纹缓缓荡向镜头。
【音效】"呼——蓬"的舒缓划水节奏，换气声轻而清晰。

[00:05.5-00:08.5] 第二式：滚转变仰泳（Roll → Backstroke）
她在水中侧身一滚翻成仰面——切头顶俯拍机位：她脸朝上漂游，双臂轮流向后划出风车弧线，长发在头后的水里散成一片扇形随波摆动，眼睛望着顶棚光影，嘴角带笑，水珠从抬起的指尖甩落。
【音效】滚转一声水响，之后是左右交替的轻快划水声。

[00:08.5-00:11.5] 第三式：滚转变自由泳（Roll → Freestyle）
她再侧滚翻回俯身——切侧面平行跟移机位：双臂交替抡水向前，侧脸贴水换气，打腿踢出细碎白沫，速度感起来，发丝随每次转头在水面甩出弧线，身后拉出一条长长的浪花尾迹伸向泳道深处。
【音效】划水声变得连贯有力，节奏渐快。

[00:11.5-00:14] 第四式：蝶泳压轴（Butterfly, Super Slow-mo）
正面水面机位升格：她双臂同时抡起越过头顶，胸背波浪起伏，每次划水在身前炸开一对对称的水花翅膀，水珠悬在阳光里发亮，抬头换气瞬间水从下颌成帘滑落，长发向后甩出一道水弧。
【音效】升格段"哗——哗——"的划水鼓点被拉长，水珠洒落如碎铃。

[00:14-00:15] 收尾：下潜定格（The Descent）
她顺势下潜，切水下机位：身体在光网里舒展成一条线滑行，长发向后飘散，她回头望向镜头露出笑容，气泡从唇边升起，画面定格。
【音效】水声归于宁静的低频嗡响，定格配一声上扬收束音。

【备注】四种泳姿姿态必须分明：蛙泳对称蹬夹、仰泳面部朝上、自由泳交替划臂、蝶泳双臂同步波浪推进；泳姿切换只用水中滚转或下潜滑行完成，全程不出现池壁；长发是贯穿全片的美学元素，每个镜头都要有发丝在水中或水面的动态

title: 15-second photorealistic cinematic video, 16:9, with synchronized stereo audio.
prompt:
15-second photorealistic cinematic video, 16:9, with synchronized stereo audio.

A female explorer with short black hair, a red waterproof jacket, and a gray backpack remains perfectly consistent inside an abandoned Victorian greenhouse during a nighttime storm.

0–4s: A low-angle tracking shot follows her walking across the wet floor. Her boot hits a puddle, creating a physically accurate splash.

4–8s: Without a cut, the camera moves into a medium side-tracking shot. She pushes aside a wet branch as a brass mechanical hummingbird emerges, circles her head, and casts warm golden light across her face.

8–12s: The camera performs a fluid 120-degree orbit. She extends her hand and the hummingbird lands precisely on her finger. Its wings slow naturally as water droplets fall from its metallic body. She says in Spanish, with natural lip sync: “Así que eras real.”

12–15s: Lightning illuminates the greenhouse. A rapid rack focus reveals an enormous bioluminescent flower opening in the background and releasing glowing blue particles. The explorer and hummingbird turn toward it simultaneously. End with a slow push toward the flower.

35mm anamorphic cinematography, natural depth of field, realistic physics, coherent reflections, detailed skin, blue storm light contrasted with the hummingbird’s golden glow.

Immersive stereo rain, wind, vibrating glass, synchronized footsteps and splashes, spatial mechanical buzzing, clean dialogue, and one deep musical note when the flower opens.

Priorities: absolute character and wardrobe consistency, stable hummingbird design, correct anatomy, natural hands, precise physical contact, coherent movement, consistent lighting, and continuous camera motion. Exactly one explorer and one hummingbird. No subtitles, text, logos, or additional characters.
